name: Workato Enterprise MCP
description: Turns Workato API collections, project assets, and proxied MCP servers into hosted MCP servers for Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, for enterprise integration teams.

skills.name: Custom MCP Servers
skills.description: Builds hosted MCP servers from API collections, project assets, or proxied external MCP servers in Workato's AI Hub.

skills.name: Verified User Access
skills.description: Runs tool calls with each end user's own credentials for systems like Salesforce or Snowflake, respecting their permissions.

skills.name: Enterprise Context Search
skills.description: Searches connected data sources and knowledge bases with permission-aware results through the native Enterprise Context MCP server.

skills.name: Workspace Management
skills.description: Manages Workato workspace assets and projects from Claude Desktop, Cursor, or ChatGPT through the Developer API MCP server.

skills.name: MCP Usage Dashboard
skills.description: Tracks tool call volume, success rate, response time, errors, and estimated token usage across your Workato MCP servers.
